articleTitle: Automated Black-Box Testing of RESTful APIs Using Enhanced Artificial Bee Colony
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Black box testing of Restful APIs is essential as the API's source code is not always available for public access. Some previous studies focused on automating black box testing; but none of them focused on optimizing the coverage and the size of the test suite. This paper propos es enhancements to the Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) swarm intelligence algorithm to be utilized for the automatic generation of test suites for Restful APIs based on Open API Specifications (OAS); whilst maximizing the API test coverage and minimizing the test suite size. Experiments were conducted on eight APIs with varying levels of complexity. The experiments showed that the enhanced ABC is superior to the ABC in terms of the sizes of the generated test suites and their coverage percentages.

articleTitle: The Adoption and Usage of SAFe in Financial Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: -Agile methods have become prevalent solutions among the financial institutions; Hence, Scaled Agile frameworks are being adopted, largely due to their success factors. Even though these Agile methods were initially developed for small software projects, their success in delivering such, have led so many financial institutions to scale them to fit their projects portfolios. The objective of this paper is to understand how SAFe is being adopted in financial in stitutions. Furthermore, the paper seeks to address how financ ial institutions use SAFe. The research adopted the quantitative method an d a survey was used to collect data from the intended audience. The research discovered that more and more organisations in the financial sector are adopting and using the SAFe framework, due to the benefits that it brings.

articleTitle: See-Shop System: An Assistive Outdoor Navigation System for the Visual Impaired Based on Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Visually impaired and blind individuals often encounter challenges in locating stores on the street, requiring guidance to ensure their daily activities are safe and effective. The objective of this study is to develop an assisted navigation system based on real-time semantic segmentation and Chinese text recognition. The proposed system aims to assist visually impaired individuals in obtaining information about the relative location of stores. It is highly user-friendly and can provide coordinate references in unfamiliar environments, aiding them in various activities like navigation and purchasing. In this work, we utilize the BiseNet v2 network, a real-time semantic segmentation model, to identify and detect shop sign objects. Additionally, we employ PP-OCR v3, an ultra-lightweight Optical Character Recognition (OCR) network, for Chinese text recognition. Furthermore, the system incorporates a speech broadcast function to convert visual information into auditory feedback. By providing real -time support for visually impaired individuals, this assistive navigation application demonstrates great potential in promoting public welfare.

articleTitle: Aligning Models with Their Realization through Model-Based Systems Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method for aligning models with their realization through the application of model-based systems engineering. Our approach is divided into three steps. (1) Firstly, we leverage domain expertise and the Unified Architecture Framework to establish a reference model that fundamentally describes some domain. (2) Subsequently, we instantiate the reference model as specific models tailored to different scenarios within the domain. (3) Finally, we incorporate corresponding run logic directly into both the reference model and the specific models. In total, we thus provide a practical means to ensure that every implementation result is justified by business demand. We demonstrate our approach using the example of maritime object detection as a specific application (specific model/implementation element) of automatic target recognition as a service reoccurring in various forms (reference model element). Our approach facilitates a more seamless integration of models and implementation, fostering enhanced Business-IT alignment.

articleTitle: Utilizing Semantic Transformation in Event Streams
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Semantic transformation is a necessary requirement in the exchange of messages between heterogenous applications. With the increase in applied sensor technologies, stream processing architectures have emerged as a critical processing capability for enterprises. This paper provides a discussion on two different stream architecture styles. The first is the publish and subscribe pattern and the second is the stream process. In both cases, a solution is presented and evaluated to integrate semantic data transformation so that downstream applications can provide analytics beyond the original sensor IDs and their measurements.

articleTitle: A Root Cause Analysis Method for Abnormal Production in Discrete Manufacturing Workshop
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) is the process to reveal the true cause of a problem. In the manufacturing field, abnormal production (AP) may cause it impossible for production plans to be completed on time. Therefore, identification of the causes of AP is a crucial process in manufacturing, and only after finding the root cause and addressing it, can it be possible to improve the manufacturing operation. As in the era of big data, sensorization of manufacturing environments has expanded, increasing with it the data available by data acquisition technology (e.g. industrial internet of things, digital twin, etc.), this study proposes a cause analysis model (CAM) of AP with SHAP and support vector machine (SVM). First, a classification model of AP based on SVM is established; second, an explainable model of AP based on SHAP is established; third, a case of RCA of AP is designed. The experimental results show that the proposed method can realize cause analysis of AP and has good performance.

articleTitle: Knowledge-Driven Analysis Framework of Anomaly Propagation in Manufacturing Workshop
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: With the improvement of customization demand and the increase of market fluctuation, manufacturing enterprises gradually turn to intelligent manufacturing mode. However, there are various abnormal events in the manufacturing process, which hinder the normal production of the workshop. The analysis of anomaly propagation is considered to be an effective technique to solve this problem. In this paper, we propose a knowledge driven analysis framework of anomaly propagation in workshop. Firstly, a temporal knowledge graph(TKG) is built for anomaly propagation analysis based on the open platform communications unified architecture (OPC UA) information model and the ontology web language (OWL) mapping model. The time-series data in the manufacturing process is contained in the TKG, such as workpiece process data, machine maintenance data, etc. These data are the basis for the analysis of anomaly propagation. Then, a time-series analysis method for anomaly is proposed. This method gives the breadth and depth of abnormal events propagation in a period of time, so that decision makers can make decisions in advance to precisely control the production process. The analysis framework provides a route for manufacturing workshop to resolve abnormal events.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Intelligent Financial Sharing Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Emerging digital technologies such as 5G technology, big data engine and artificial intelligence have promoted the birth of intelligent finance. Intelligent finance highly integrates finance, business, tax and management, leading a new financial model. This paper constructs an intelligent financial sharing platform based on the integration of business and finance, and discusses the internal structure of the platform. Then, taking Dongguan Zhongcheng Pharmaceutical Group as an example, the operation of the intelligent financial sharing platform is introduced, and the processing flow of the company's online reimbursement platform is analyzed. Practice has proved that the intelligent financial sharing platform realizes intelligent and visual approval throughout the process, improves process efficiency, provides support for enterprise risk prevention and standardized control, and provides effective support for enterprise operation and management decisions.

articleTitle: Research on Decision-Making Optimization of New Energy Vehicle Supply Chain Considering Stigma Level
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: In recent years, despite the rapid development of the new energy vehicle (NEV) industry, the continuous emergence of stigmatization incidents around car battery life has also brought challenges to corporate decision-making optimization. In order to solve this problem, we construct a model for the supply chain structure composed of NEV manufacturers and battery manufacturers under the two situations of information disclosure or no information disclosure, and then solves the model based on Stackelberg game theory. In order to further analyze the results, we also use numerical examples to verify the model results. The results show that the stigma level negatively affects the optimal pricing and profits of enterprises; If the information disclosure decision-making is taken, it is conducive to reducing the profit loss of NEV manufacturers and battery manufacturers; Interestingly, the information disclosure decision-making adopted by NEV manufacturers is more conducive to reducing the profit loss of battery manufacturers than it is for itself.

articleTitle: Approach to Reuse of Unity Game Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Peculiarities of development application with game engines allow organizing a reuse of game scene assets during requirement analysis process. Effective requirement analysis is a background for successful performing of projects. In game development, such artifacts as game scenes prototypes may replace tons of text from requirement specification and become a good alternative of UML diagrams or other software models of processes. In-place g ame scene reuse approach for different types of game scenes (2D, 2.5D, and 3D) that raises a maturity level of reuse procedure and allows avoiding duplicating design errors when Game Scenes are reused is proposed on the paper. Considered approach is focused on two tasks fixing design errors for reusable assets and integrating of new assets to game scene. For every asset the procedure of reviewing its design and behavioral characteristics (scrips features) is performed. Approach clearly defines common and specific activi ties for different types of the scenes. This fact simplifies the procedure of its study and improvement of reuse experience. In addition, approach considers that author laws may protect some game scenes assets Experimental results, summar izing errors for designing of different scenes, are represented.

articleTitle: Big Data Addressed in Natural Language
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Actions related to the cloud processing of large volumes of semi- or unstructured, streaming data (so-called “Big Data”) pose challenges that organizations must address. They are related to the location of the data in the cloud, its storage and management. Much of Big Data is collected from sources that are external to the business organization, such as social media, demographics, web data, events, news sources, and more. In this article, we discuss an access method to enable support for very large Big Data databases. It is based on the capabilities of Natural Language Addressing (NLA). An important advantage of NLA is the reduction of the amount of occupied memory due to the complete absence of additional indexes, absolute addresses, pointers and additional files, as well as the reduction of processing time due to the complete absence of searches - data is stored / retrieved to / from a direct address.

articleTitle: Distributed Data Addressed in Natural Language
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: A distributed database management system provides the functionality of a centralized, but in an environment where data is distributed among the sites of a computer network or the nodes of a multiprocessor system. In this paper, we use a data storage approach based on Natural Language Addressing capabilities to support very large distributed databases with O(1) time complexity. We introduce two new data structures: a universal NLA-space and a concrete NLA-space. The NLA-space is a fundamentally new structure for the organization of distributed databases, which does not replace but naturally complements other widely used structures of database management systems. NLA-spaces open a wide field for research and practical implementation in the field of large databases with dynamic semistructured data (Big Data).

articleTitle: Advantages of BIM Technology Application: A Case Study of a Construction Company
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: At present, China's construction industry is very prosperous, but the overall profits of construction enterprises are relatively low. The industrialization and informatization level of the construction industry is still relatively low, and the advantages and value of BIM have not been fully utilized in China's construction industry. As one of the effective ways to improve the efficiency and profits of the engineering construction industry, the application level of BIM technology needs to be improved. We must keep up with the development of the times, constantly learn new knowledge and technologies, and jointly promote the development of the industry [1]. This study will use random sampling method to collect data through online questionnaire surveys. By collecting data and analyzing the application, influencing factors, and current situation of BIM technology in leading enterprises in the Chinese construction industry, it can be determined whether BIM technology has application prospects and significance in construction. At the same time, through research and analysis, further gain the application advantages of BIM technology, and help enterprises better utilize BIM technology for the benefit of enterprises.

articleTitle: Multi-Feature Classification Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: This research proposes an improvement for distance-based classification algorithms, specifically focusing on the K-nearest neighbors (KNN) algorithm. The proposed method involves dividing the chosen da taset into multiple clusters and subsequently running KNN on each cluster separately. Each cluster represents a separate subset of data. By partitioning the dataset into clusters, the main goal is to reduce the complexity of the classification within each subset. The analysis of the new model presents improvements in the predictions in the sub-datasets compared to the transitional distance analysis prediction. Our study's results highlight the proposed method's potential to enhance distance-based classification algorithms. The model can be used for a variety of market domains and achieve better performance in the classification of critical tasks. It is recommended that future research continues to explore and refine this method to advance distance-b ased classification algorithms and facilitate more accurate and reliable predictions in various fields and use cases.

articleTitle: Unveiling Gender Dynamics: Examining Gender Moderation Effects on the Relationship of Subjective Norms, Attitude, and Intention Towards E-Wallet Adoption in Tajikistan
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Progress for women is hampered in Tajikistan by enduring gender differences in earnings, political representation, and involvement in the labour force. Gender-specific problems continue because men earn more across all industries and there are a lot of young women who are Not in Education, Employment or Training (NEET). Given the potential of digital financial inclusion to improve economic opportunities for women, it is crucial to look into how these gender dynamics impact e-wallet usage. This study investigates how gender affects the relationship between e-wallet usage intention, attitude, and subjective norms in Tajikistan. Complete responses were given by 288 males and 127 women who took part in the survey. The results show that gender has an impact on the ways that attitude, intention, and subjective norms affect the use of e-wallets. The adoption of e-wallets by women is substantially influenced by their views, whereas male intention is driven by subjective norms. Stakeholders should give gender equality a high priority across all sectors, particularly finance, in light of the gender differences in Tajikistan's employment, compensation, and political landscape. Initiatives focused on financial education are advised to improve understanding of the advantages of e-wallets. It is recommended to adopt customized marketing strategies that consider how gender influences e-wallet use. Government, financial institutions, and civil society collaboration are essential for promoting the adoption of gender-inclusive e-wallets.

articleTitle: SecureIIoT: A Cybersecurity Approach for Industrial Internet of Things Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: With the application of Internet of Things (loT) in industrial contexts, companies managed to create the fourth step in the industrial revolution, the Industry 4.0 (14.0). In this era, industries use various machines, devices, sensors, and systems to enhance operational efficiency, optimize business processes and enable data driven decision-making. Despite that, security concerns within these environments have been very prevalent, as not only do these industries have an increased attack surface over traditional factories, but also loT devices are usually not designed with robust security features in mind. Companies that want to adopt the 14.0 paradigm must address this situation and consider cybersecurity as a mandatory step towards this adoption. However, applying security measures in Industrial Internet of Things (1IoT) environments can be quite challenging, and even though there are many well established cybersecurity frameworks and international standards, these documents can be very extensive and sometimes hard to follow, as they are generic to cover a wide range of businesses. The main goal of this work is to present a security framework designed for IloT environments, that dictates a more direct and simpler approach in the form of a specific set of actions needed to secure these types of environments. The work was based on a real case study of a mould industry environment.

articleTitle: OMIT: An Instrument to Aid Implementation of a Data Ownership Model in Data Governance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: We present a ‘work in progress' paper, based on a master's thesis, focusing on data ownership models within data governance. The literature shows that there is a lack of practically useful aides or instruments for establishing a good, made-to-measure data ownership model for enterprises, as part of a more general data governance strategy and framework. Based on a literature review and semi structu red interviews with experienced experts in the field of data governance, we determined key concepts and factors relevant to the design of a data ownership model. N ext, we designed an initial tool in the shape of a questionnaire, called ‘Ownership Model Implementation Tool’ (OMIT). Through additional expert interviews, we evaluated and finalized the instrument as well as guidelines for using it. Our main contribution is the OMIT itself, but its underlying concepts should also be useful to the data governance community. As the OMIT has not yet been tested within or ganizations, the obvious step for future research would be to evaluate and further refine the tool in practice.

articleTitle: Architecture to Productize Semantic Transformation by Utilizing Natural Language Processing with Microservices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Semantic transformation is a necessary requirement in translating message values between various applications so that these messages can be processed. The transformation utilizes several patterns that can be implemented using a microservices architecture. The collaboration of these microservices needs to be managed. This paper discusses the orchestrated and choreographed approaches for this scenario. To demonstrate the choreographed approach, the paper presents a natural language query processing solution that can use custom vocabularies for microservice invocations to achieve semantic message transformations.

articleTitle: Feature Engineering Procedure for Information Enrichment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Data is essential for an organization's development, maintenance, and building of intelligence systems. Furthermore, AI procedures are key to generating recommendations when data contains multiple features. A notable challenge in developing a descriptive or predictive model is reducing the number of features to increase the model's performance metrics. Selecting a significant set of features for a dataset requires human intervention and analysis due to the diversity of techniques suitable for different models. Ho wever, insignificant features often need to be used in the models. This study presents a novel method for generating relevant features and enriching the dataset for learning. It is based on measuring the shared information between features and dividing the dataset into two subsets according to their similarities, such that one is more informative than the other. The significant advantage of our method is the increased ability to detect patterns in the dataset, leading to dimensionality reduction or enhanced performance metrics (i.e., precision, recall) for each target in the dataset. We tested our procedure using six datasets. The results showed an improvement of up to 43.75% in the recall, 20.77% in precision, and 29.62% in the weighted fl-score.

articleTitle: Market Segmentation of Aquilaria Sinensis-Classification of Consumers' Lifestyle Typologies
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Aquilaria sinensis (also known as Guanxiang in Chinese) is one of the special agarwood in South China. It is mainly produced and traded in Dongguan, Guangdong, China. Aquilaria sinensis is highly valuable for medicine, fragrance and decoration purposes. However, only few people are aware of its existence in China, and even the local Dongguan residents are unfamiliar with it. This paper introduces the lifestyle segmentation method to analyze consumers' behavior in Aquilaria sinensis market. We used a series of activities, interests and opinions to access lifestyle typologies of the consumers. Factor analysis identified three key factors that potentially influence the consumer behavior: cultural value factor, activity experience factor and consumer preference factor. The cluster analysis revealed four types of market segments in Aquilaria sinensis products: the freshmen who know nothing about Aquilaria sinensis, the “nouveau riche” who can afford it and prefer to experience it, the “old money” who pursue life quality and social status, and the “poor but exquisite” who appreciate it but can not afford it. Finally, according to these four types of market segments, some market development advice are discussed for the upgrading and popularization of Aquilaria sinensis products.

articleTitle: XAI for User Classifications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Explainable artificial inte lligence (XAI) models are artificial intelligence (AI) systems comprising learned algorithms and outputs that users can trust and understand. In this study, an XAI method is suggested in the context of topic modeling, which allows users to understand how an AI system makes classifications. This method is an innovative procedure to re-engineer the process of user classification on the server side, applying mathematical calculations done on the user side. Our proposed method yielded highly accurate results. This method provides users with an improved understanding and awareness of how the system classifies their preferences. Therefore, users are able to control and adjust the recommendations they receive from the AI system.

articleTitle: Development and Validation of an Approach for Assessing the Risk and Health of IT Project Portfolios
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Many organizations have established IT Project Portfolio Management to effectively manage portfolios of IT projects and balance them with their business strategy. Despite quite significant investments in IT projects and following IT Project Portfolio Management best practices, organizations often fail to actually realize the expected value with their project portfolio. To realize portfolio value now and in the future, a periodic assessment of the so-called health and risks of the IT project portfolio is essential. Several portfolio management standards have been published, but the scientific literature still lacks a theoretically based and practically validated approach for assessing IT project portfolio value in terms of health and risk. This study established such an approach for assessing IT project portfolio value, validated in a multiple-case study. We argue that this approach can support organizations in assessing their IT project portfolio in terms of health and risk, identifying areas for improvement, and thus having better control over realizing portfolio value.
